# Project Instructions

- This is a static browser MVP for NFT Depot using test credits only.
- Preserve the existing visual language and keep game state in app.js.
- Do not add real-money payments, NFT custody, or withdrawal processing to the client.
- Production integrations require a server-side balance ledger, authentication, admin review, rate limiting, and legal compliance.
- Validate with browser testing when Node.js is unavailable.
